_help: Reviewer output, ingested with `ba.py review-record reviews/<reviewer>.json`. reviewer: business-logic|regression|test-quality|security|architecture|coderabbit. status: COMPLETED (scope_inspected must list what you actually read) | NOT_APPLICABLE (rationale >= 20 chars). severity: CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW|INFORMATIONAL (impact x likelihood, not preference). All finding text fields are required; line is an integer or null. Remove the placeholder finding if you have none - an empty findings list is valid.
